# Slot religion: puts the voted/decreed law back on top of the government package.
DVE_rf_reapply_religion_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_religion }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_religion = 1 } } add_ideas = rf_religion_state_atheism }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_religion = 2 } } add_ideas = rf_religion_secular_state }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_religion = 3 } } add_ideas = rf_religion_recognised_faiths }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_religion = 4 } } add_ideas = rf_religion_state_church }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_religion = 5 } } add_ideas = rf_religion_theocratic_law }
	}
}

# Slot religion: government package (package_apply = always); skipped when the slot was voted.
DVE_rf_package_religion_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_religion } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = totalitarian_socialism has_government = authoritarian_socialism } } add_ideas = rf_religion_state_atheism }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = vanguard_socialism has_government = revolutionary_socialism has_government = progressive has_government = liberal } } add_ideas = rf_religion_secular_state }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = centrist has_government = authoritarianism has_government = autocracy } } add_ideas = rf_religion_recognised_faiths }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = conservative has_government = reactionary has_government = absolutism has_government = ultranationalism } } add_ideas = rf_religion_state_church }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = fundamentalism } add_ideas = rf_religion_theocratic_law }
	}
}

		add_ideas = press_censorship
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 27 } }
		add_ideas = state_media
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 28 } }
		add_ideas = regulated_press
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 29 } }
		add_ideas = free_press
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 5 }
	}
}

# Slot press: puts the voted/decreed law back on top of the government package.
DVE_rf_reapply_press_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_press }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 1 } } add_ideas = total_censorship }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 2 } } add_ideas = press_censorship }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 3 } } add_ideas = state_media }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 4 } } add_ideas = regulated_press }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 5 } } add_ideas = free_press }
	}
}

# Slot trade: current position (DVE_rf_cpos, 0 = unknown) and vector (DVE_rf_cE/cL/cC) of the current law.
DVE_rf_cur_trade_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = free_trade }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = -2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = managed_trade }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = -1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_idea = export_focus } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 3 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = restricted_trade }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = limited_exports }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 5 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -2 }
	}
}

# Slot trade: enacts the selected option (k = DVE_rf_sel_opt); add_ideas replaces the occupant of the idea slot.
DVE_rf_apply_trade_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 30 } }
		add_ideas = free_trade
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 31 } }
		add_ideas = managed_trade
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 32 } }
		add_ideas = export_focus
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 33 } }
		add_ideas = restricted_trade
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 34 } }
		add_ideas = limited_exports
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 5 }
	}
}

# Slot trade: puts the voted/decreed law back on top of the government package.
DVE_rf_reapply_trade_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_trade }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 1 } } add_ideas = free_trade }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 2 } } add_ideas = managed_trade }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 3 } } add_ideas = export_focus }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 4 } } add_ideas = restricted_trade }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 5 } } add_ideas = limited_exports }
	}
}

# Slot trade: government package (package_apply = startup_if_default); skipped when the slot was voted, locked.
DVE_rf_package_trade_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_trade } NOT = { DVE_rf_trade_locked_trigger = yes } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = totalitarian_socialism has_government = reactionary has_government = autocracy has_government = absolutism has_government = fundamentalism } } add_ideas = restricted_trade }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = authoritarian_socialism has_government = vanguard_socialism has_government = revolutionary_socialism has_government = progressive } } add_ideas = managed_trade }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = liberal } add_ideas = free_trade }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = centrist has_government = conservative has_government = authoritarianism } } add_ideas = export_focus }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = ultranationalism } add_ideas = limited_exports }
	}
}

# GUI click on the plate of slot trade.
DVE_rf_open_slot_trade_effect = {
	DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = yes
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 7 }
	DVE_rf_cur_trade_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_rows_effect = yes
}

# Slot taxes: current position (DVE_rf_cpos, 0 = unknown) and vector (DVE_rf_cE/cL/cC) of the current law.
DVE_rf_cur_taxes_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_tax_minimal }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = -2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = low_taxation }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = -1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_idea = moderate_taxation } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 3 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = high_taxation }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_tax_confiscatory }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 5 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -1 }
	}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_milspend_10pct }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 5 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -2 }
	}
}

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_military_spending = 2 } } add_ideas = rf_milspend_2pct }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_military_spending = 3 } } add_ideas = rf_milspend_3pct }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_military_spending = 4 } } add_ideas = rf_milspend_5pct }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_military_spending = 5 } } add_ideas = rf_milspend_10pct }
	}
}

		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = vanguard_socialism has_government = revolutionary_socialism has_government = progressive has_government = liberal has_government = centrist } } add_ideas = rf_milspend_2pct }
	}

# Slot growth: current position (DVE_rf_cpos, 0 = unknown) and vector (DVE_rf_cE/cL/cC) of the current law.
DVE_rf_cur_growth_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_growth_pronatalist }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_growth_family_incentives }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_growth_natural } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 3 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_growth_family_planning }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_growth_birth_limits }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 5 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -2 }
	}
}

# Slot growth: enacts the selected option (k = DVE_rf_sel_opt); add_ideas replaces the occupant of the idea slot.
DVE_rf_apply_growth_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 58 } }
		add_ideas = rf_growth_pronatalist
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 59 } }
		add_ideas = rf_growth_family_incentives
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 60 } }
		add_ideas = rf_growth_natural
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 61 } }
		add_ideas = rf_growth_family_planning
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 62 } }
		add_ideas = rf_growth_birth_limits
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 5 }
	}
}

# Slot growth: puts the voted/decreed law back on top of the government package.
DVE_rf_reapply_growth_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_growth }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 1 } } add_ideas = rf_growth_pronatalist }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 2 } } add_ideas = rf_growth_family_incentives }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 3 } } add_ideas = rf_growth_natural }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 4 } } add_ideas = rf_growth_family_planning }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 5 } } add_ideas = rf_growth_birth_limits }
	}
}

# Slot growth: government package (package_apply = always); skipped when the slot was voted.
DVE_rf_package_growth_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_growth } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = totalitarian_socialism has_government = authoritarian_socialism has_government = progressive } } add_ideas = rf_growth_family_planning }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = vanguard_socialism has_government = conservative has_government = reactionary has_government = absolutism } } add_ideas = rf_growth_family_incentives }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = revolutionary_socialism has_government = liberal has_government = centrist has_government = authoritarianism has_government = autocracy } } add_ideas = rf_growth_natural }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = ultranationalism has_government = fundamentalism } } add_ideas = rf_growth_pronatalist }
	}
}

		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = progressive has_government = liberal has_government = centrist } } add_ideas = volunteer_only }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = ultranationalism has_government = fundamentalism } } add_ideas = extensive_conscription }

		limit = { has_idea = rf_suffrage_appointed }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_suffrage_restricted }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = -1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_suffrage_managed }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 3 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_suffrage_universal }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_suffrage_direct }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 5 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 1 }
	}
}

# Slot suffrage: enacts the selected option (k = DVE_rf_sel_opt); add_ideas replaces the occupant of the idea slot.
DVE_rf_apply_suffrage_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 79 } }
		add_ideas = rf_suffrage_appointed
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 80 } }
		add_ideas = rf_suffrage_restricted
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 81 } }
		add_ideas = rf_suffrage_managed
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 82 } }
		add_ideas = rf_suffrage_universal
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 83 } }
		add_ideas = rf_suffrage_direct
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 5 }
	}
}

# Slot suffrage: puts the voted/decreed law back on top of the government package.
DVE_rf_reapply_suffrage_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_suffrage }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 1 } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_appointed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 2 } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_restricted }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 3 } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_managed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 4 } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_universal }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 5 } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_direct }
	}
}

# Slot suffrage: government package (package_apply = always); skipped when the slot was voted.
DVE_rf_package_suffrage_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_suffrage } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = totalitarian_socialism has_government = authoritarian_socialism has_government = ultranationalism } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_managed }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = vanguard_socialism has_government = revolutionary_socialism } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_direct }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = progressive has_government = liberal has_government = centrist has_government = conservative } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_universal }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = reactionary has_government = authoritarianism has_government = fundamentalism } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_restricted }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = autocracy has_government = absolutism } } add_ideas = rf_suffrage_appointed }
	}
}

# GUI click on the plate of slot suffrage.
DVE_rf_open_slot_suffrage_effect = {
	DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = yes
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 17 }
	DVE_rf_cur_suffrage_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_rows_effect = yes
}

# Slot parties: current position (DVE_rf_cpos, 0 = unknown) and vector (DVE_rf_cE/cL/cC) of the current law.

	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 0 }

		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 1 }

		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 1 }

		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -1 }

		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -1 }
	}

		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 104 } }
		add_ideas = rf_ni_basic_port_upkeep
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 105 } }
		add_ideas = rf_ni_commercial_ports
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 106 } }
		add_ideas = rf_ni_naval_yard_programme
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 107 } }
		add_ideas = rf_ni_blue_water_network
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 5 }
	}
}

# Slot naval_infrastructure: puts the voted/decreed law back on top of the government package.
DVE_rf_reapply_naval_infrastructure_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_naval_infrastructure }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 1 } } add_ideas = rf_ni_port_neglect }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 2 } } add_ideas = rf_ni_basic_port_upkeep }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 3 } } add_ideas = rf_ni_commercial_ports }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 4 } } add_ideas = rf_ni_naval_yard_programme }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 5 } } add_ideas = rf_ni_blue_water_network }
	}
}

# Slot naval_infrastructure: government package (package_apply = always_if_coastal); skipped when the slot was voted.
DVE_rf_package_naval_infrastructure_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_naval_infrastructure } any_owned_state = { is_coastal = yes } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = totalitarian_socialism has_government = authoritarian_socialism has_government = progressive has_government = liberal has_government = centrist has_government = conservative has_government = authoritarianism } } add_ideas = rf_ni_commercial_ports }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = vanguard_socialism has_government = revolutionary_socialism has_government = reactionary has_government = autocracy has_government = absolutism has_government = fundamentalism } } add_ideas = rf_ni_basic_port_upkeep }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = ultranationalism } add_ideas = rf_ni_naval_yard_programme }
	}
}

# GUI click on the plate of slot naval_infrastructure.
DVE_rf_open_slot_naval_infrastructure_effect = {
	DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = yes
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 22 }
	DVE_rf_cur_naval_infrastructure_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_rows_effect = yes
}

# Slot econ_mobilization: current position (DVE_rf_cpos, 0 = unknown) and vector (DVE_rf_cE/cL/cC) of the current law.
DVE_rf_cur_econ_mobilization_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = civilian_economy }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = -1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_idea = low_economic_mobilisation } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 2 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = partial_economic_mobilisation }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 3 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = war_economy }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = tot_economic_mobilisation }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 5 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = light_economic_mobilisation }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = -1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rising_economic_mobilisation } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 2 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = advancing_economic_mobilisation }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 3 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = near_total_economic_mobilisation }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = -1 }
	}
}

# Slot econ_mobilization: enacts the selected option (k = DVE_rf_sel_opt); add_ideas replaces the occupant of the idea slot.
DVE_rf_apply_econ_mobilization_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 108 } }
		add_ideas = civilian_economy
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 109 } }
		add_ideas = low_economic_mobilisation
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 110 } }
		add_ideas = partial_economic_mobilisation
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 111 } }
		add_ideas = war_economy
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 112 } }
		add_ideas = tot_economic_mobilisation
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 5 }
	}
}

# Slot econ_mobilization: puts the voted/decreed law back on top of the government package.
DVE_rf_reapply_econ_mobilization_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_econ_mobilization }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 1 } } add_ideas = civilian_economy }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 2 } } add_ideas = low_economic_mobilisation }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 3 } } add_ideas = partial_economic_mobilisation }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 4 } } add_ideas = war_economy }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 5 } } add_ideas = tot_economic_mobilisation }
	}
}

# Slot econ_mobilization: government package (package_apply = never); skipped when the slot was voted, locked.
DVE_rf_package_econ_mobilization_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_econ_mobilization } NOT = { DVE_rf_econ_mobilization_locked_trigger = yes } } if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = totalitarian_socialism has_government = authoritarian_socialism has_government = vanguard_socialism has_government = revolutionary_socialism has_government = progressive has_government = liberal has_government = centrist has_government = conservative has_government = reactionary has_government = authoritarianism has_government = autocracy has_government = absolutism has_government = ultranationalism has_government = fundamentalism } } add_ideas = civilian_economy } }
}

	DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = yes
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 23 }

	DVE_rf_rows_effect = yes
}

# Slot research: current position (DVE_rf_cpos, 0 = unknown) and vector (DVE_rf_cE/cL/cC) of the current law.
DVE_rf_cur_research_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_rs_market_driven }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = -2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_rs_targeted_grants } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 2 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_rs_national_programme }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 3 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cC = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rf_rs_state_directed_science }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cE = 2 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_cL = -1 }
	}
}

# Slot research: enacts the selected option (k = DVE_rf_sel_opt); add_ideas replaces the occupant of the idea slot.
DVE_rf_apply_research_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 113 } }
		add_ideas = rf_rs_market_driven
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_research = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 114 } }
		add_ideas = rf_rs_targeted_grants
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_research = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 115 } }
		add_ideas = rf_rs_national_programme
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_research = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 116 } }
		add_ideas = rf_rs_state_directed_science
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_research = 4 }
	}
}

# Slot research: puts the voted/decreed law back on top of the government package.
DVE_rf_reapply_research_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_research }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_research = 1 } } add_ideas = rf_rs_market_driven }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_research = 2 } } add_ideas = rf_rs_targeted_grants }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_research = 3 } } add_ideas = rf_rs_national_programme }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_law_research = 4 } } add_ideas = rf_rs_state_directed_science }
	}
}

# Slot research: government package (package_apply = always); skipped when the slot was voted.
DVE_rf_package_research_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_research } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = totalitarian_socialism } add_ideas = rf_rs_state_directed_science }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = authoritarian_socialism has_government = vanguard_socialism has_government = revolutionary_socialism has_government = progressive has_government = ultranationalism } } add_ideas = rf_rs_national_programme }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = liberal has_government = centrist has_government = conservative has_government = authoritarianism } } add_ideas = rf_rs_targeted_grants }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = reactionary has_government = autocracy has_government = absolutism has_government = fundamentalism } } add_ideas = rf_rs_market_driven }
	}
}

# GUI click on the plate of slot research.
DVE_rf_open_slot_research_effect = {
	DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = yes
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 24 }
	DVE_rf_cur_research_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_rows_effect = yes
}

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 3 } } DVE_rf_cur_assembly_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 4 } } DVE_rf_cur_trade_unions_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 5 } } DVE_rf_cur_courts_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 6 } } DVE_rf_cur_press_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 7 } } DVE_rf_cur_trade_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 8 } } DVE_rf_cur_taxes_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 9 } } DVE_rf_cur_child_labour_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 10 } } DVE_rf_cur_work_hours_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 11 } } DVE_rf_cur_land_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 12 } } DVE_rf_cur_military_spending_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 13 } } DVE_rf_cur_growth_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 14 } } DVE_rf_cur_borders_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 15 } } DVE_rf_cur_equality_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 16 } } DVE_rf_cur_mobilization_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 17 } } DVE_rf_cur_suffrage_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 18 } } DVE_rf_cur_parties_effect = yes }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 24 } } DVE_rf_cur_research_effect = yes }
}

# Atlas frame of the current law of every slot (default option frame when unknown or locked).
DVE_rf_refresh_plates_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_religion = 3 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_religion_state_atheism } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_religion = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_religion_secular_state } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_religion = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_religion_recognised_faiths } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_religion = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_religion_state_church } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_religion = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_religion_theocratic_law } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_religion = 5 } }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_education = 8 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_education_elite_schooling } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_education = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_education_state_curriculum } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_education = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_education_public_schooling } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_education = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_education_comprehensive } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_education = 9 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_education_open_science } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_education = 10 } }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_assembly = 13 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_assembly_banned } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_assembly = 11 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_assembly_licensed } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_assembly = 12 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_assembly_regulated } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_assembly = 13 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_assembly_free } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_assembly = 14 } }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade_unions = 17 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = unions_banned } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade_unions = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = unions_tolerated } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade_unions = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = unions_allowed } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade_unions = 17 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = state_labour_unions } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade_unions = 18 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = workers_labour_union } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade_unions = 19 } }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_courts = 22 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = strict_justice } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_courts = 20 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = formal_justice } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_courts = 21 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = ordinary_justice } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_courts = 22 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_courts_independent } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_courts = 23 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = equal_justice } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_courts = 24 } }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_press = 29 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = total_censorship } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_press = 25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = press_censorship } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_press = 26 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = state_media } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_press = 27 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = regulated_press } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_press = 28 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = free_press } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_press = 29 } }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade = 32 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DVE_rf_trade_locked_trigger = yes } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = free_trade } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade = 30 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = managed_trade } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade = 31 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = export_focus } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade = 32 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = restricted_trade } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade = 33 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = limited_exports } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_trade = 34 } }
	}
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_taxes = 36 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = rf_tax_minimal } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_taxes = 35 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = low_taxation } set_variable = { DVE_rf_cur_taxes = 36 } }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt > 0 } check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 7 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_orf7 = 2 } }
}

# DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 1 unless the selected option has an unmet prerequisite (prereq_extra: every OR-list must hold) or gate.
DVE_rf_prereq_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 5 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = religious_state has_government = fundamentalism } } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 19 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = syndicalist_economy has_idea = socialist_economy has_idea = communist_economy } } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 57 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_war = yes } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 79 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { NOT = { has_idea = tolerated_dissent } } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 83 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = tolerated_dissent has_idea = rf_parties_extremist_ban } } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 109 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_war_support = 0.15 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 110 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_war_support = 0.25 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 111 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_war_support = 0.5 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 112 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { has_war = yes has_war_support = 0.8 } } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 } } }
}

# DVE_rf_dist: graph distance current -> selected (0 same, 1, 2, 9 = farther; unknown current counts as 1).
DVE_rf_dist_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 9 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 0 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 1 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 2 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 1 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 2 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 4 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 1 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 2 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 4 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 5 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 2 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 4 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 5 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 5 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 4 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 5 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 0 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 1 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 2 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 1 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 2 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 4 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 1 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 2 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 4 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 5 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 2 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 4 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 5 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 5 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 4 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 5 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 0 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_cpos = 0 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } }

# (extremists vote against), locked flag, persuasion, seats and totals (SPEC 3b).

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_st_reactionary = 0 } } add_to_variable = { DVE_rf_a = DVE_rf_seat_reactionary } }
	# authoritarianism  position +4
	set_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_do = DVE_rf_ideal_authoritarianism }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_do = DVE_rf_cpx }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_do < 0 } } multiply_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_do = -1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_dn = DVE_rf_ideal_authoritarianism }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_dn = DVE_rf_sel_pos }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dn < 0 } } multiply_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_dn = -1 } }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_dot_authoritarianism = DVE_rf_do }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dot_authoritarianism < 0 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_st_authoritarianism = -1 } }

	set_variable = { DVE_rf_lk_authoritarianism = 0 }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dot_authoritarianism < 0 } check_variable = { DVE_rf_ideal_authoritarianism = DVE_rf_mxp } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_lk_authoritarianism = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_ex_authoritarianism = 1 } check_variable = { DVE_rf_dot_authoritarianism > 0 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_lk_authoritarianism = 1 } }

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_st_authoritarianism < -1 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_st_authoritarianism = -1 } }

# Full recomputation of the proposal (called by every GUI click): totals zeroed, current law, selected option, R = clamp(V_new - V_cur),
# distance, legality, decree class and cost, stances, totals, pass flag, popup rows.
DVE_rf_recalc_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_y = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_a = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_tot = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_yp = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_np = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_ap = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_margin = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_marginabs = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_ok = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_legal_vote = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_legal_decree = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_dcost = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstab = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstabp = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 9 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot > 0 } }
		DVE_rf_cur_dispatch_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt > 0 } }
			DVE_rf_load_selected_effect = yes
			set_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_tE = DVE_rf_nE }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_tE = DVE_rf_cE }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = DVE_rf_tE min = -2 max = 2 }
			set_variable = { DVE_rf_RE = DVE_rf_tE }
			set_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_tL = DVE_rf_nL }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_tL = DVE_rf_cL }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = DVE_rf_tL min = -2 max = 2 }
			set_variable = { DVE_rf_RL = DVE_rf_tL }
			set_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_tC = DVE_rf_nC }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { DVE_rf_tC = DVE_rf_cC }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = DVE_rf_tC min = -2 max = 2 }
			set_variable = { DVE_rf_RC = DVE_rf_tC }
			DVE_rf_dist_effect = yes
			DVE_rf_prereq_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_prereq_ok = 1 } NOT = { DVE_rf_sel_slot_locked_trigger = yes } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 1 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_legal_vote = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dist > 0 } check_variable = { DVE_rf_dist < 3 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_legal_decree = 1 } }
			}
			set_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = DVE_rf_dcls_base }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dist = 2 } } add_to_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls > 4 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 4 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 1 } }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dcost = 150 }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstab = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstabp = 3 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 2 } }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dcost = 300 }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstab = 0.05 }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstabp = 5 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 3 } }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dcost = 500 }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstab = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstabp = 8 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 4 } }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dcost = 800 }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstab = 0.1 }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_dstabp = 10 }
			}
			DVE_rf_stances_effect = yes
			set_variable = { DVE_rf_tot = DVE_rf_y }
			add_to_variable = { DVE_rf_tot = DVE_rf_n }
			add_to_variable = { DVE_rf_tot = DVE_rf_a }
			set_variable = { DVE_rf_margin = DVE_rf_y }
			subtract_from_variable = { DVE_rf_margin = DVE_rf_n }
			set_variable = { DVE_rf_marginabs = DVE_rf_margin }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_margin < 0 } } multiply_variable = { DVE_rf_marginabs = -1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_margin > 0 } } set_variable = { DVE_rf_ok = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_tot > 0 } }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_yp = DVE_rf_y }
				multiply_variable = { DVE_rf_yp = 100 }
				divide_variable = { DVE_rf_yp = DVE_rf_tot }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_np = DVE_rf_n }
				multiply_variable = { DVE_rf_np = 100 }
				divide_variable = { DVE_rf_np = DVE_rf_tot }
				set_variable = { DVE_rf_ap = DVE_rf_a }
				multiply_variable = { DVE_rf_ap = 100 }
				divide_variable = { DVE_rf_ap = DVE_rf_tot }
			}
		}
		DVE_rf_rows_effect = yes
	}
}

# Back to IDLE (no slot, no option, no result, no persuasion).
DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 0 }
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_result = 0 }
	DVE_rf_reset_pers_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_recalc_effect = yes
}

		set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 0 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_result = 0 }
		DVE_rf_recalc_effect = yes
	}
}

}

# Shared by pass and decree: apply the option, voted flag, 70-day slot cooldown, persistence markers.
DVE_rf_enact_effect = {
	DVE_rf_apply_dispatch_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_religion
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_religion days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 2 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_education
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_education days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 3 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_assembly
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_assembly days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 4 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_trade_unions
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_trade_unions days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 5 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_courts
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_courts days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 6 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_press
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_press days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 7 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_trade
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_trade days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 8 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_taxes
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_taxes days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 9 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_child_labour
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_child_labour days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 10 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_work_hours
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_work_hours days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 11 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_land
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_land days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 12 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_military_spending
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_military_spending days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 13 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_growth
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_growth days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 14 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_borders
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_borders days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 15 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_equality
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_equality days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 16 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_mobilization
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_mobilization days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 17 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_suffrage
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_suffrage days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 18 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_parties
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_parties days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 19 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_healthcare
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_healthcare days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 20 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_law_order
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_law_order days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 21 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_infrastructure
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_infrastructure days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 22 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_naval_infrastructure
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_naval_infrastructure days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 23 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_econ_mobilization
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_econ_mobilization days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 24 } }
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_research
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_cd_research days = 70 value = 1 }
	}
	set_country_flag = DVE_rf_any_voted
	if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } set_country_flag = DVE_rf_was_subject }
}

# Vote button: fresh recalc, 25 PP filing fee (lost on failure), pass iff yes > no; slot cooldown on pass, 14-day lock on failure, 7-day global gap.
DVE_rf_vote_effect = {
	DVE_rf_recalc_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { DVE_rf_can_vote_trigger = yes }
		add_political_power = -25
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_res_opt = DVE_rf_sel_opt }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_res_yp = DVE_rf_yp }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_res_np = DVE_rf_np }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_res_ap = DVE_rf_ap }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_ok = 1 } }
			DVE_rf_enact_effect = yes
			set_variable = { DVE_rf_result = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_ok = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 1 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_religion days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 2 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_education days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 3 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_assembly days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 4 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_trade_unions days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 5 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_courts days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 6 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_press days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 7 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_trade days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 8 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_taxes days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 9 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_child_labour days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 10 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_work_hours days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 11 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_land days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 12 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_military_spending days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 13 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_growth days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 14 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_borders days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 15 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_equality days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 16 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_mobilization days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 17 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_suffrage days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 18 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_parties days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 19 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_healthcare days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 20 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_law_order days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 21 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_infrastructure days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 22 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_naval_infrastructure days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 23 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_econ_mobilization days = 14 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_slot = 24 } } set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_fcd_research days = 14 value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { DVE_rf_result = 2 }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_gcd days = 7 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 0 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 0 }
		DVE_rf_reset_pers_effect = yes
		DVE_rf_refresh_plates_effect = yes
		DVE_rf_recalc_effect = yes
	}
}

# Decree button: PP by class, stability loss only with elections, 60-day global decree gap.
DVE_rf_decree_effect = {
	DVE_rf_recalc_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { DVE_rf_can_decree_trigger = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 1 } } add_political_power = -150 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 2 } } add_political_power = -300 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 3 } } add_political_power = -500 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 4 } } add_political_power = -800 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 1 } has_elections = yes } add_stability = -0.03 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 2 } has_elections = yes } add_stability = -0.05 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 3 } has_elections = yes } add_stability = -0.08 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_dcls = 4 } has_elections = yes } add_stability = -0.1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_res_opt = DVE_rf_sel_opt }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_res_yp = DVE_rf_yp }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_res_np = DVE_rf_np }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_res_ap = DVE_rf_ap }
		DVE_rf_enact_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = { flag = DVE_rf_dcd days = 60 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_result = 3 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_opt = 0 }
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_sel_pos = 0 }
		DVE_rf_reset_pers_effect = yes
		DVE_rf_refresh_plates_effect = yes
		DVE_rf_recalc_effect = yes
	}
}

# Result popup acknowledged.
DVE_rf_clear_result_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_result = 0 }
}

# Close the slot popup.
DVE_rf_close_slot_effect = {
	DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_refresh_plates_effect = yes
}

# Close the Reforms window.
DVE_rf_close_window_effect = {
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_win_open
	DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = yes
}

# Button of the Political Parties panel: open the Reforms window.
DVE_rf_toggle_window_effect = {
	set_country_flag = DVE_rf_win_open
	clr_country_flag = DVE_party_panel_open
	DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_refresh_plates_effect = yes
}

# Forget every voted/decreed law (the government package wins again).
DVE_rf_clear_voted_effect = {
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_religion
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_religion = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_education
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_education = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_assembly
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_assembly = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_trade_unions
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade_unions = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_courts
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_courts = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_press
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_press = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_trade
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_trade = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_taxes
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_taxes = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_child_labour
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_child_labour = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_work_hours
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_work_hours = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_land
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_land = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_military_spending
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_military_spending = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_growth
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_growth = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_borders
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_borders = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_equality
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_equality = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_mobilization
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_mobilization = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_suffrage
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_suffrage = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_parties
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_parties = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_healthcare
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_healthcare = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_law_order
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_law_order = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_infrastructure
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_infrastructure = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_naval_infrastructure
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_naval_infrastructure = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_econ_mobilization
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_econ_mobilization = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_voted_research
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_law_research = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_any_voted
}

# Puts every voted law back on top of the package (idempotent).
DVE_rf_reapply_voted_effect = {
	DVE_rf_reapply_religion_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_education_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_assembly_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_trade_unions_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_courts_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_press_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_trade_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_taxes_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_child_labour_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_work_hours_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_land_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_military_spending_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_growth_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_borders_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_equality_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_mobilization_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_suffrage_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_parties_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_healthcare_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_law_order_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_infrastructure_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_naval_infrastructure_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_econ_mobilization_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reapply_research_effect = yes
}

# Government package of the new slots (package_apply always / always_if_coastal).
DVE_rf_package_effect = {
	DVE_rf_package_religion_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_education_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_assembly_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_child_labour_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_land_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_military_spending_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_growth_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_borders_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_equality_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_suffrage_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_healthcare_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_law_order_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_infrastructure_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_naval_infrastructure_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_research_effect = yes
}

# Old saves: fills only the new slots that hold no option at all (never re-runs the full package).
DVE_rf_package_fill_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_religion_state_atheism has_idea = rf_religion_secular_state has_idea = rf_religion_recognised_faiths has_idea = rf_religion_state_church has_idea = rf_religion_theocratic_law } } } DVE_rf_package_religion_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_education_elite_schooling has_idea = rf_education_state_curriculum has_idea = rf_education_public_schooling has_idea = rf_education_comprehensive has_idea = rf_education_open_science } } } DVE_rf_package_education_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_assembly_banned has_idea = rf_assembly_licensed has_idea = rf_assembly_regulated has_idea = rf_assembly_free } } } DVE_rf_package_assembly_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_cl_tolerated has_idea = rf_cl_restricted has_idea = rf_cl_banned has_idea = rf_cl_youth_service } } } DVE_rf_package_child_labour_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_land_estates has_idea = rf_land_freehold has_idea = rf_land_smallholder has_idea = rf_land_state has_idea = rf_land_commons } } } DVE_rf_package_land_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_milspend_1pct has_idea = rf_milspend_2pct has_idea = rf_milspend_3pct has_idea = rf_milspend_5pct has_idea = rf_milspend_10pct } } } DVE_rf_package_military_spending_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_growth_pronatalist has_idea = rf_growth_family_incentives has_idea = rf_growth_natural has_idea = rf_growth_family_planning has_idea = rf_growth_birth_limits } } } DVE_rf_package_growth_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_borders_sealed has_idea = rf_borders_strict has_idea = rf_borders_managed has_idea = rf_borders_free_movement } } } DVE_rf_package_borders_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_equality_hierarchy has_idea = rf_equality_assimilation has_idea = rf_equality_limited_rights has_idea = rf_equality_equal_citizenship has_idea = rf_equality_pluralism } } } DVE_rf_package_equality_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_suffrage_appointed has_idea = rf_suffrage_restricted has_idea = rf_suffrage_managed has_idea = rf_suffrage_universal has_idea = rf_suffrage_direct } } } DVE_rf_package_suffrage_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_hc_private_only has_idea = rf_hc_safety_net has_idea = rf_hc_mandatory_insurance has_idea = rf_hc_universal_service has_idea = rf_hc_socialised_medicine } } } DVE_rf_package_healthcare_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_lo_minimal_policing has_idea = rf_lo_community_policing has_idea = rf_lo_professional_police has_idea = rf_lo_gendarmerie has_idea = rf_lo_political_police } } } DVE_rf_package_law_order_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_im_deferred_maintenance has_idea = rf_im_basic_upkeep has_idea = rf_im_maintained_network has_idea = rf_im_steady_expansion has_idea = rf_im_national_investment } } } DVE_rf_package_infrastructure_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_ni_port_neglect has_idea = rf_ni_basic_port_upkeep has_idea = rf_ni_commercial_ports has_idea = rf_ni_naval_yard_programme has_idea = rf_ni_blue_water_network } } } DVE_rf_package_naval_infrastructure_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_idea = rf_rs_market_driven has_idea = rf_rs_targeted_grants has_idea = rf_rs_national_programme has_idea = rf_rs_state_directed_science } } } DVE_rf_package_research_effect = yes }
}

# Trade and mobilisation package, used only when voted laws are wiped (puppet, ideology exception); mobilisation never during a war.
DVE_rf_package_restore_effect = {
	DVE_rf_package_trade_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_war = yes } } DVE_rf_package_mobilization_effect = yes }
}

# DVE_rf_gi = index 1..14 of the ideology group in power.
DVE_rf_calc_gov_idx_effect = {
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_government = totalitarian_socialism } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = authoritarian_socialism } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = vanguard_socialism } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = revolutionary_socialism } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = progressive } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = liberal } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = centrist } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = conservative } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = reactionary } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 9 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = authoritarianism } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = autocracy } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 11 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = absolutism } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 12 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = ultranationalism } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 13 } }
	if = { limit = { has_government = fundamentalism } set_variable = { DVE_rf_gi = 14 } }
}

# After the existing packages ran (on_ruling_party_change): ideology package wins only when the group changed to revolutionary_socialism,
# vanguard_socialism or fundamentalism; otherwise the new slots follow the package except voted ones, which are put back.
DVE_rf_government_changed_effect = {
	DVE_rf_calc_gov_idx_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { DVE_rf_gov_idx = DVE_rf_gi } } OR = { has_government = revolutionary_socialism has_government = vanguard_socialism has_government = fundamentalism } }
		DVE_rf_clear_voted_effect = yes
		DVE_rf_package_effect = yes
		DVE_rf_package_restore_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		DVE_rf_package_effect = yes
	}
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_gov_idx = DVE_rf_gi }
	DVE_rf_reapply_voted_effect = yes
}

# Exception (a): a subject loses its voted laws and gets the plain packages.
DVE_rf_puppet_reset_effect = {
	set_country_flag = DVE_rf_was_subject
	DVE_rf_clear_voted_effect = yes
	DVE_set_economic_model_effect = yes
	DVE_set_state_policies_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_package_restore_effect = yes
	DVE_rf_reset_proposal_effect = yes
}

# Weekly safety net (no on_action exists for every way of becoming a subject); gated by flags, cheap for the AI.
DVE_rf_subject_watch_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DVE_rf_any_voted
			is_subject = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_was_subject }
		}
		DVE_rf_puppet_reset_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_was_subject is_subject = no } clr_country_flag = DVE_rf_was_subject }
}

# Start of game and new tags: package of the new slots, trade package only over the default law, government index.
DVE_rf_startup_effect = {
	DVE_rf_package_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_idea = export_focus } DVE_rf_package_trade_effect = yes }
	DVE_rf_calc_gov_idx_effect = yes
	set_variable = { DVE_rf_gov_idx = DVE_rf_gi }
	if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } set_country_flag = DVE_rf_was_subject }
	set_country_flag = DVE_rf_defaults_done
}

# on_weekly: subject watcher, one-time fill for old saves, government index.
DVE_rf_weekly_effect = {
	DVE_rf_subject_watch_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DVE_rf_defaults_done } }
		DVE_rf_package_fill_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = DVE_rf_defaults_done
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = DVE_rf_gov_idx } }
		DVE_rf_calc_gov_idx_effect = yes
		set_variable = { DVE_rf_gov_idx = DVE_rf_gi }
	}
}
